consumer_prediction.procedure_counterfactual: With the identical authored QOK+CHDY consumer requiring a Component and the same explicit SHEDAL Fluid, replacing OTCHDY output by a bare Procedure leaves a missing Component argument. An explicit invocation/participant rule can repair the procedure rival only as a separately priced model; if invocation creates Event E0 plus participant C, QOKCHDY creates distinct Transit E1. A has no E0 and retains C_H as introduced referent. A procedure-reference interpretation may instead carry a participant address without invocation; that adds a dependency and may restore graph equivalence.
consumer_prediction.not_shared_known_rule: QOK component arity, deferred fluid argument, SOL referent restoration and CHEDY component predicate are authored C0. No independent semantic rule distinguishes the two readings in the current packet.
consumer_prediction.third_rival: GDT318 contextual-entry wrapper: ot/qok may expose the same Cdy content under script/layout conditions, with q after DY. Formal component cache supports nomination, not my semantic operator difference.
consumer_prediction.rename_assessment: Keeping A-specific physical Component/Fluid/Transit predicates fixed, a bare operation prototype cannot be substituted for C_H without changed arity/participant/invocation structure. Letting all predicates and sorts be globally reinterpreted as in FS leaves semantic relabeling possible. Thus a conditional constructed consequence is supplied, not an empirical meaning-selection victory.
